items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: "First we wanted Commitator. You know why I talk to her. We wanted her because she was a musician."

ctx.x: Ask me if he was playing with Louis Dumaine after he went to Mexico or before he went to Mexico.

Was you playing with Louis Dumaine before you went to Mexico or after? Or before I went to Mexico. Yeah. Because we had some, we were speaking to some, I tell you, two husbands. First we wanted Commitator. You know why I talk to her. We wanted her because she was a musician. And them bands, there was one of all them bands away from the sweet sports. All of them were four or five piece bands. So they tried to knock it to the white people that, we had a good band but they read them old notes. And the white people…
What about, what about Bud Russel or Bud Russell?
